Thanks again for the product overview last week. Our engineers reviewed the docs and we'd like to set up a focused architecture deep-dive to walk through: SDK integration patterns (Java + Node), streaming responses and backpressure handling, and function/tool calling semantics for our document ingestion pipeline.
